findings: Billaudot identifies Paul Pierné as composer of this E-flat saxophone and piano work, plate CC2842.

The Royal Conservatoire Antwerp library catalog identifies it as number 1 of Trois pièces, published by Costallat and dedicated to Marcel Mule. This supports an attribution correction rather than assuming the Gabriel Pierné entry is a different work.
